disposition_rules.supported: Accept only the exact command token with its grouped record validator. Raw-only records are retained verbatim and do not imply typed state support.
disposition_rules.recognized_unsupported: Reject before side routing or publication. Aliases carry an unresolved-alias diagnostic; -singlemove truncates the episode before commit.
disposition_rules.malformed_supported: Reject before side routing and publication. Episode handling classifies malformed evidence as failed; it is not a supported mechanic.
disposition_rules.unknown: Reject before side routing and publication; episode handling truncates on unsupported protocol.
disposition_rules.privacy: Requests remain private; only the sanitized rqid record is allowed in a public prefix. All other request JSON is rejected at publication.
